hardware: Windows, Intel A770 16GB, Xeon E5-2696 v4, 256GiB RAM
scope: Native DG2 maintains conservative inclusive CPU-mapping bounds: two uint64_t values per Runtime (16 bytes). Addresses outside these bounds skip only the CPU-mapping scan, then perform the existing GPU-residency validation. Addresses inside bounds, including gaps, retain the complete ordered CPU scan before GPU validation. Successful host allocation/import widens bounds; frees never shrink them. Upper-limit arithmetic saturates at UINT64_MAX. Existing per-payload-field GPU-resident hints remain enabled.
baseline: Previously adopted per-payload-field resident hints, validated storage-index hint, single argument pack, local-ID payload reuse, fused expert activation and one owner handoff per pair; earlier non-adopted candidates absent

cpu_bounds_benchmark.scope: Actual pack_arguments, 64-byte cross-thread payload, four captured pointers as distinct args or one aggregate; both arms retain per-payload-field resident hints. 8/32/128/512 allocations, one in four CPU-mapped. Pattern 0: GPU pointers outside CPU bounds; pattern 1: GPU pointers in gaps inside bounds; pattern 2: true CPU pointers. Changing interior offsets, one warm batch and seven retained batches of 32768, A0/B/A1. CPU only, no model throughput estimate.

adoption_criterion: Positive overall measured prefill and TTFT direction, exact outputs and numerical checks, no material case regression. User accepts positive gains below 1%; no 1% adoption hard gate.
isolation: Previous per-payload-field resident-hint runtime plus only conservative CPU bounds, host-mapping allocation hooks on DRM/WDDM, helper/call-site plumbing and CPU checks. Exactly five changed frozen source files. Same owner/engine objects and math images; current tree runtime separately built and GPU-checked. In-place payload and nested image maps absent.

checks.coverage: Existing resident-hint checks plus exact bounded/unbounded translation and rejection equivalence after mapping growth/removal/clear/reorder, retained conservative bounds after frees, empty mappings, base/last-byte/one-past/zero/UINT64_MAX, saturated inclusive upper limit, four aggregate pointer fields, captured CPU/GPU pointers and CPU/GPU numeric-overlap priority

model.protocol: Native conservative CPU-mapping bounds A0/B/A1: Short anchor, one Code2K/Prose2K warmup each (saved), two retained cycles each; no phase profiling
